strategy.signal: closed H1 red/green reversal aligned with current M5/M15 detectWave; conflicting lower-timeframe directions rejected
strategy.entry: STOP beyond current H1 extreme by 2 pips; 60-minute expiry
strategy.stop: opposite current H1 extreme plus 2-pip buffer
strategy.ambiguity: bid/ask execution; stop before target inside an ambiguous M1 candle

caveats: M1 OHLC does not reveal tick order; ambiguous stop/target/trailing paths are resolved conservatively.
A pending STOP fill is modeled at its requested level; gap slippage and broker fees beyond the recorded spread are unavailable.
Each period starts independently with EUR 1000, so period balances are directly comparable but do not chain.
